driver: Events counted per unit are judged against what each unit gives when sound, and units differ persistently beyond any recorded feature, so the null must carry a level per unit learned from that unit's independently verified periods outside the record being judged, and carry that level's uncertainty into the tail; a scatter taken period by period passes the units that always run high as failures and hides the low ones that fail, a level taken as known breaks the false-alarm budget, and the value of acting is the state each failure has reached, not the record's average
driver_concrete: Each zone's lightning faults are its reclosers' trips matched to located strokes on each controller's own clock with the overwritten and unread months restored; what its lines would have had with sound protection is the register-feature rate times its own level (soil, hardware, route), learned from the seasons a later inspection confirmed it sound; the referral is the predictive tail of its record since inspection at one sound zone in five seasons across the network; the refit is valued on the 2026 state
stump: A careful run that rebuilds the record and learns from inspection-confirmed seasons but takes the scatter season by season refers 13 zones against 11 (it adds two that run high whenever sound, and a third, and drops a failed zone that runs low), replays 2, 5, 4, 10 and 13 referrals against 2, 2, 4, 8 and 11, checks 8 referrals at inspection with one found sound, and values the refit on each zone's record since inspection averaged (83 against 116); one that finds each zone's level but takes it as known refers 17 and would refer a sound zone 1.2 times a season against the terms' 0.2
results: R1 the network's lightning faults per season, reconstructed on every protective device's own clock, with the radio-less zones' lost and unread months restored; R2 2026's lightning faults failed protection caused (the season against every zone sound at its own level); R3 the zones the rule refers for the 2027 refit; R4 the referred zones' record since inspection against sound protection at their own levels; R5 its alert load (referrals after each season since 2022 and the sound zones a season's referrals should hold); R6 its referrals against the following cyclic inspections; R7 the lightning faults the refit avoids, at the state each failure had reached by the end of 2026
one_fact_test: 'a zone that runs high when its protection is sound runs high every season: judge each zone against its own confirmed-sound seasons', executed as a run acts on it (each level taken as known), rescues R2 and R4 (2 of 7) and refers 17; the level-uncertainty sentence rescues nothing alone; the failures-began-partway sentence rescues R7; the clocks-and-memories sentence rescues nothing from the careful pass, which already rebuilds the record

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what restoring a unit's condition removes from its next-period event count, which is only the part of its event rate that has grown since the condition was last restored, per unit of an exposure that drives every event; the latest counts mix that growth with each unit's own base and with an exposure that moved in opposite directions across areas, so the units that look worst were selected on a high-exposure year or on a high base the restoration cannot touch, and the units with the most to gain look ordinary.

Its record: the storm-track swing between stations was thin (one plot of gust hours by station shows it), the plantation feeders' dense corridor sat only in the deciding units with one filter as the fix (a send-back), and every graded figure came out of one Poisson fit (one thing under another name).

lineage.niche: a Philippine electric cooperative's referral rule for the overhead protection zones whose lightning protection (arrester ground leads, line arresters, pin insulators) has failed, built from recloser event logs on their own clocks and a lightning location extract, ahead of the 2027 dry-season refit
lineage.driver: Events counted per unit are recorded by instruments that keep their own drifting time and only their last few hundred records, read on an observer's schedule, so the units with the most events lose the most and line up the worst with the independent record that classifies them; the expected count each unit should have is learned only from unit-periods that a later physical check confirmed sound, and the alarm threshold carries the spread those confirmed units show beyond chance.
lineage.stump: A careful run that matches the radio-less controllers' trips to strokes on a wide window around their own stamps, counts only the events their memories kept and fits the sound-protection rate on every season no inspection has yet found failed refers 2 zones against 15: the baseline holds the failing zones it should judge, the wide window counts storm trips as lightning and the lost and unread months are missing, so the season totals, the radio-less faults, the failed-protection faults, the alert load, the inspection check and the avoided faults are all off, each by a different route.
lineage.answer: refer BGS-F3-R2, BGS-F5-R2, BTG-F1-R3, CBR-F2-R2, CLB-F5-R1, DLP-F2-R2, DLP-F4, LRD-F1-R1, LRD-F2, LRD-F2-R1, LRD-F3-R3, MPD-F2-R1, PGP-F1-R2, PGP-F2-R3 and SNJ-F1 for the 2027 refit (15 zones); the rule refers a zone when its lightning faults since its last cyclic inspection exceed the inspection-confirmed sound expectation by more than their scatter allows, at 1 in 855 a zone a season
